task: Write top_words(text, n) that returns a list of the n most common words in text, lowercased, most common first.
check: assert top_words('a b A c b a', 2) == ['a', 'b']

task: Write chunked(items, size) that splits a list into consecutive lists of at most size items.
Write week_start(day) that takes a date as an ISO string like '2024-05-15' and returns the Monday of that week as an ISO string.
Write sha256_hex(text) that returns the SHA-256 digest of a string, UTF-8 encoded, as lowercase hex.
Write flatten(nested) that turns a list of lists into one flat list, one level deep.
Write parse_pairs(text) that turns a string like 'a=1;b=2' into the dict {'a': '1', 'b': '2'}. An empty string gives an empty dict.
Write median_of(numbers) that returns the median of a non-empty list of numbers.
Write dedupe(items) that removes duplicates from a list while keeping the first occurrence of each item in order.
Write roman(n) that converts an integer from 1 to 3999 to a Roman numeral string.
check: assert roman(1994) == 'MCMXCIV' and roman(4) == 'IV' and roman(3999) == 'MMMCMXCIX'

task: Write slugify(title) that lowercases a title, replaces every run of characters that are not letters or digits with a single hyphen, and strips hyphens from both ends.
check: assert slugify('Hello, World!  Again') == 'hello-world-again' and slugify('--A--') == 'a'
